entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please say the reason for your call.
Connecting you to an agent now.
Hi, thank you for calling VeloFit. My name is Karen. How can I help you today?
Hi Karen, I'd like to return a VeloBand Pulse HR monitor I bought back in December.
No problem, I can definitely look into that for you. Can I get your name and order number, please?
Sure, the name is Alex Miller, and the order number is VF-9875-PULSE.
Thank you, Alex. One moment... Okay, I see your order here from December 15th. It looks like you're well within the 90 days for a return, so we can absolutely get that processed for you.
Oh, that's great! I wasn't sure what the policy was, especially for that device. I'm glad it's that long.

It certainly is! And I see here you're one of our VIP members. As a thank you for your loyalty, I've just added a $25 credit to your account for your next purchase. I'm also emailing you the pre-paid return label right now. Just pack the VeloBand back in its original box, stick the label on, and drop it off.
Wow, a credit too? That's fantastic, thank you so much, Karen. You've made this really easy.

It's my pleasure, Alex! Once we receive the item back at our warehouse, you'll see the full refund to your original payment method in 3-5 business days. Is there anything else I can help you with today?
Nope, that's all. You've been a great help.
Wonderful. Thank you again for calling VeloFit, and have a great day!
